secrets.name: LEAD_ENGINE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Admin password for the dashboard login gate. Set this to control who can access the command center.

secrets.name: LEAD_ENGINE_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret used to sign session cookies. Generate a random string.

secrets.name: TAVILY_API_KEY

secrets.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
secrets.description: Brave search API key (search provider pool). Optional.

secrets.name: EXA_API_KEY
secrets.description: Exa search API key (search provider pool). Optional.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (LLM provider pool, highest priority). Optional.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key (LLM provider pool). Optional.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key (LLM provider pool). Optional.

secrets.name: APOLLO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Apollo.io API key for people/company data enrichment. Optional.

secrets.name: HUNTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: Hunter.io API key for email finding/verification. Optional.

secrets.name: ABSTRACT_API_KEY
